description_en: Verifies the C2PA digital signature in an image and returns the signature status and issuer information
description_zh: 验证图片中的C2PA数字签名，返回签名状态及签发者信息
name: VerifyImageSignature

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to verify. Specify either ImageUrl or ObjectKey. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh: 待验证图片的 URL 地址。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the image in OSS. When you use ObjectKey, ensure that the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. Specify either ImageUrl or ObjectKey. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh: 待验证图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: object_key

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value "OK" is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

CommonName.description_en: The common name (CN) of the issuer

Organization.description_en: The organization name (O) of the issuer

IssuerTrusted.description_en: Indicates whether the issuer is trusted. A value of true indicates that the issuer certificate is issued by a trusted CA
IssuerTrusted.description_zh: 签发者是否可信。true 表示签发者证书由受信任的 CA 签发

Manifest.description_en: The content credentials manifest information. This parameter is returned only when the image contains a C2PA signature
Manifest.description_zh: 内容凭证清单信息。仅在图片包含 C2PA 签名时返回

Assertions.description_en: The list of assertions, which contains metadata such as the origin and editing history of the image
Assertions.description_zh: 断言信息列表，包含图片的来源和编辑历史等元数据

Data.description_en: The assertion data, which is detailed metadata in JSON format
Data.description_zh: 断言数据，JSON 格式的详细元数据

Label.description_en: The assertion label, such as c2pa.actions or stds.exif
Label.description_zh: 断言标签，如 c2pa.actions、stds.exif 等

Alg.description_en: The signature algorithm, such as `ps256` or `es256`

Issuer.description_en: The distinguished name (DN) of the signing certificate issuer
Issuer.description_zh: 签名证书的签发者 DN

Time.description_en: The signing time in ISO 8601 format

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

VerificationState.description_en:
The signature verification status. Valid values:
Valid: The signature is valid.
Invalid: The signature is invalid or has been tampered with.
Trusted: The signature is valid and trusted
VerificationState.description_zh: 签名验证状态。取值：Valid（签名有效）、Invalid（签名无效或已被篡改）、Trusted(签名有效且被信任）
